summary: Experienced Network & Security Engineer with 12 years in managing and securing enterprise-level networks across banking, finance, and global IT infrastructure. Proven expertise in designing, implementing, and supporting robust network architectures with a strong focus on security, compliance, and high availability. Adept in handling Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, and Juniper technologies, and leading cross-functional teams in large-scale global projects including datacenter migration, firewall onboarding, and policy optimization.
